theme: Speaking an old protocol over a new engine
title: Handshake Shim: Emulating Unmappable Wire Messages Under Observable-State Fidelity
strategies: do-nothing shim: emit zero NEW messages for every OLD type (reproduces the checker's own baseline -> ~0.1)

safe 1:1 shim: substitute a single NEW message only where an exact match exists, refuse (no-op) on unmappable OLD types -- correct until the first unmappable type in a session, then the shim's own carried-forward state diverges and every later checkpoint in that session is wrong too

compositional shim: search sequences of up to 2 NEW messages via matrix composition (exploiting that internal scratch resets to 0 per call, so the observable-projected composition is an exact affine map of the observable input for every session) -- recovers an exact emulation for every OLD type, so state never cascades wrong
any table that mixes exact single/double matches with a small complexity budget, trading off unnecessary extra emitted messages against fidelity
